page.overview:
Who is Rasmus Blys?

Rasmus Blys was a Special Executive and biochemist of Czerka Corporation and was in charge of CZ-198, one of Czerka's many product development facilities, one that Rasmus Blys built up himself. Blys was well educated on the subject of biochemistry and other sciences and had designed multiple award-winning Czerka patents in the usage of DNA and cybernetics to create biological weapons. He also created the deadly bioweapon, the Vigilant which became the last line of security on CZ-198.

In 3638 BBY, when the Republic decided to shut down and absorb the Czerka Corporation, Rasmus Blys, unlike many of his colleges who turned to the Empire for help, decided to stand his ground on CZ-198, independent from both sides. As both the Republic and the Empire sent in their strike teams, CZ-198 facility's defenses proved insufficient against them, and in the battle for the moon Rasmus was killed.

Rasmus Blys first appeared in Game Update 2.3 of the MMORPG Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel, released by BioWare in 2013.
